item.title: Captures: forum-list badge N > 1, leading newline in forms, nonlu.php without cookies (#117, #130, #137)
item.body:
Closes #117
Closes #130
Refs #137 (`nonlu.php` only; the rest of the issue stays open)
Claim: mac/m2-lead

**Problem.** Three pending captures of the backlog #337.

**Captures** (run 11, MANIFEST rows `R117a`, `R130a`-`R130e`, `W130`, `W131`, `W137a`, `W137b`, oracles in `Fixtures/M2-misc/`):
- `R117a`: the header badge with N > 1 on a list page; legacy reads `needToUpdateMP` true, `sNewMPNumber` 7.
- `W130`, `R130a`-`R130c`: HFR stores a leading CRLF; the thread renders it; the edit form serves the text without it, the quote form keeps it. A browser that drops a leading newline therefore corrupts nothing.
- `W137a`, `W137b`: `nonlu.php` without cookies answers the `.hop` "Ce message ne vous est pas destiné, désolé", byte-identical to `R96c`, and the second send to the first.
- `W131`, `R130d`, `R130e`: a delete by one side removed the thread for the other here; one observation, unlike `R95k`.

Writes: one MP between the operator's accounts and its delete, operator-approved; the two cookie-less requests. Thread removed.

**Tests.** `HopResponseParserTests` lists `W130` and `W131`. `check --corpus`, `swift test`, pre-commit green. Independent check passed.
